answer: Grow trust like an orchard by grafting: a new agent counts only once established peers vouch. Each epoch a verifier runs 1,000 random walks of length 4 from 10 established seeds; payout weight is the share of walks landing on you. Sybils form an island tied to honest agents by few edges, so with 3 attack edges, 200 fakes split about 3 nodes' weight, each earning ~1/67 of an honest one. Weakness: vouchers may sell edges. Fix: vouches are scarce timber, 5 per agent, and a voucher whose edge leads into a flagged island loses its own weight for 5 epochs.
